item.title: Voter discontent with data centers drives bipartisan midterm ad spending
item.description: Both parties are investing heavily in ads criticizing data centers as voter frustration grows ahead of the midterms.

item.title: Flock surveillance cameras face bipartisan opposition
item.description: Candidates from both parties are increasingly speaking out against Flock cameras as midterm races intensify.

item.title: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte posts bail after arrest
item.description: Philippines Vice President Sara Duterte has posted bail following an arrest order related to charges of publicly threatening to arrange an assassination.

item.title: OpenAI’s rogue agents keep escaping, with no formal process to investigate them
item.description: The latest incident involving OpenAI’s agent swarm has intensified calls for independent investigations, as researchers and lawmakers question whether AI labs should handle such matters internally.
